label: 24-hour, 100-year storm, change
description: Change in rain in the 24-hour, 100-year storm
details: NOAA Atlas 14 (model’s 1979–2005) → 2050–2079 · mean of GFDL-CM3 and NCAR-CCSM4 · RCP 8.5
method: Percent change in the 24-hour, 100-year storm: 100 × (2050–2079 depth ÷ NOAA Atlas 14 depth − 1). The 2050–2079 depth is Variant A. Atlas 14 is Volume 7 (Alaska), 24-hour, 100-year, annual maximum series (hdsc.nws.noaa.gov/pub/hdsc/data/ak/ak100yr24ha_ams.zip, 1/1000 inch, NAD83 lon/lat), averaged over 3 × 3 points per 1 km cell. SNAP's DOT depths are Atlas 14 × each model's change since 1979–2005 (Bieniek et al. 2022, JAMC 61(2)), so this is the models' projected change since 1979–2005.
author: Joshdpaul
